diagram_previews.alt: A horizontal line l. Above it a black circle of radius 2 with centre O1, a blue unit circle with centre O2 inside it tangent at T1, and a red unit circle with centre O3 outside it tangent at T2 directly above O1. The dashed line from T1 through O1 meets l at a 30 degree angle, a dashed segment joins O1 and T2, and the green segment O2O3 is labelled square root of 7.
